title: Your 401(k) match: free money, every paycheck

sources.claim: Alder Street matches 100% of the first 3% and 50% of the next 2%; at a $60,000 salary that is $1,800 a year at 3% and $2,400 at 5%; the match vests 33/66/100% over three years
sources.source: Alder Street Retirement Plan summary, 2027 plan year (fictional sample plan)

beats.vo: Most new hires leave free money on the table. Right now you save three percent, and Alder Street adds three. Raise it to five, and they add four. That is nine percent of your pay, every paycheck.

props.source: Alder Street Retirement Plan summary, 2027 plan year

sketchText.EACH: Each coin is 1% of your pay

beats.vo: On a sixty thousand dollar salary, the match goes from eighteen hundred dollars a year to twenty-four hundred. Six hundred more, for two points.

props.source: Alder Street Retirement Plan summary, 2027 plan year · example: a $60,000 salary

beats.vo: The match becomes yours over three years: a third after the first, two thirds after the second, and all of it after the third. Your own money is always yours.

props.source: Alder Street Retirement Plan summary, 2027 plan year

beats.vo: It takes two minutes. Open Benefits, then Retirement. Set your rate to five percent, and save. Free money, every paycheck after.

sketchText.DONE: Saved: starts with your next paycheck

props.source: Alder Street Retirement Plan summary, 2027 plan year
